The Arctic LNG 2 Terminal power station GOGPT record (100001061607, 0.51 km, 1500 MW, 3 units, gogpt_captive=true) IS this terminal's own plant -- the geographic match (0.5 km) and name match are correct. Its 1,500 MW figure lines up closely with the confirmed Wison/Interfax 3x500MW planned electric-generation capacity, so on the evidence found it does NOT appear to conflate mechanical-drive shaft power into the 1500 MW total (that figure tracks the Wison generation modules specifically). However, the record's 3-unit count likely reflects the 3 build stages rather than actual turbine count (each stage = 4 modules x 5 CGT30 = 20 turbines, so ~60 CGT30 units across all 3 stages), and it does not capture the SEPARATE Train-1 LM9000 mechanical-drive turbines (4 units, ~260-290 MW aggregate shaft, not generating electricity) -- those should never be folded into this MW figure.
